first_impression.summary_in_own_words: A company that plans weddings in Portugal and gives you one advisor. The headline is all palaces and cliffs, which sounds big and fancy, but the second line tells me the legal wedding needs at least a month and that lots of people do a symbolic one in Portugal and the legal bit at home. Nothing up top says small or elopement, so I'm not sure yet it's for a group like ours.

attention_map.quote: Get Married in Portugal, from a Sintra Palace to an Algarve Cliff
attention_map.why: Pretty, but a palace makes me think big budget and 150 guests. The 'Check the rules for your passport' link caught my eye because the paperwork is what scares me.

attention_map.quote: How many guests? - Under 30 ... What are you celebrating? - Elopement
attention_map.why: First sign we're welcome. Under 30 and Elopement are actual options, not an afterthought.

attention_map.quote: Romantic palaces in the Sintra hills that can be booked for a wedding
attention_map.why: Lovely to look at, but it's sightseeing. I scrolled past looking for numbers.

attention_map.quote: whether you are planning an elopement, a small wedding or a three-day weekend
attention_map.why: Good, small is named. The nearest airport on every card is exactly what I want, close to an airport and simple.
Five times in a row. That's the one thing I scan for first and every card tells me to ask. Feels like the minimums are being kept for the phone call.

attention_map.quote: state events can cancel bookings at Queluz or the National Palace of Sintra
attention_map.why: Too grand and too risky for us. Nothing about whether a palace would even take 15 people.

attention_map.quote: A Catholic marriage is legally recognised on its own.
attention_map.why: Answers my church question straight away. Also good that the city council has a space for civil ceremonies, that sounds simple.

attention_map.quote: exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill ... fees may be charged either way, with a minimum
attention_map.why: This is my exact worry. It admits there are minimums and that small groups can end up paying for empty rooms, but gives no amount.

attention_map.section: Plan step by step: Marrying legally
attention_map.quote: Witnesses are optional: two to four may take part.
attention_map.why: The best part of the page for me. Clear steps, the documents listed, translation rules, and real government links. I finally know where to start.

attention_map.section: Plan step by step: Marrying legally, fee
attention_map.quote: The civil registry charges a fee for the ceremony.
attention_map.why: What fee? Everything else is so precise and then this is vague.

attention_map.quote: What a wedding in Portugal costs depends on five things
attention_map.why: No number at all, not even a starting point for a small group. Back to 'talk to us'.

attention_map.section: See What a Portugal Wedding Weekend Includes
attention_map.quote: There is no set Portugal package.
attention_map.why: I came looking for a package. Then the list is welcome dinner, late party, Sunday brunch, which is a big three-day production, not us.

attention_map.section: Bring Your Guests, or Keep It Exclusive
attention_map.quote: Exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill
attention_map.why: Second time I've read this. It reads like it's written for a big crowd.

attention_map.quote: They walk you through the exact route to marry legally for your nationality, and check each venue contract for rooms, buy-outs, minimums and VAT before you sign.
attention_map.why: One person who knows the paperwork is what I want. But 'walk you through' sounds like advice, not that they sort the documents and witnesses for us.

attention_map.quote: Elopements and small weddings are welcome.
attention_map.why: This is what I needed to hear, I just wish it was at the top. The form has Under 30, Elopement and Catholic, and a spot to put my budget.

Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez's wedding
attention_map.why: Celebrity stuff, not relevant to us.

questions_answered.question: Does this work for 30 guests or fewer, and is there a smaller package?
questions_answered.evidence: Small groups are welcome: 'Under 30' and 'Elopement' in the qualifier and form, 'Elopements and small weddings are welcome', FAQ 9 'two of you can marry with no guests at all'. But 'There is no set Portugal package' and every region card says 'Guests: Ask your Wedded Advisor', so no smaller package and no venue guest ranges.

questions_answered.question: Do you handle the legal side: documents, witnesses, registry?
questions_answered.evidence: The legal steps are very clear with official sources ('Gather your documents', 'Witnesses are optional: two to four may take part', Justiça, IRN, embassy links). The company only says 'Your Wedded Advisor walks you through the exact route for your nationality'; it never says they prepare the documents, book the registry or find witnesses.

questions_answered.question: What is the minimum spend?
questions_answered.evidence: No figure anywhere. 'fees may be charged either way, with a minimum' confirms minimums exist, and the costs section says it 'depends on five things'.

questions_answered.question: Can we have a religious ceremony (for example Catholic) here?
questions_answered.evidence: 'A Catholic marriage is legally recognised on its own.' FAQ 3 repeats it, and Catholic is a ceremony type in the form. Nothing on how a church is arranged, but the question is answered.

objections_triggered.objection: Minimum guest numbers or spend that don't fit a small group
objections_triggered.triggered_by: 'Guests: Ask your Wedded Advisor' on all five region cards; 'fees may be charged either way, with a minimum'; 'exclusive use can mean paying for rooms your guests do not fill'; no cost figure in the Costs tab
Largely calmed by the Marrying legally steps and official links. Left open by 'walks you through' (advice, not done for us) and 'The civil registry charges a fee for the ceremony' with no amount.

objections_triggered.objection: No package for a small group
objections_triggered.triggered_by: 'There is no set Portugal package.' followed by a three-day weekend list with welcome dinner, late party and Sunday brunch

trust_signals_noticed: Under 30 and Elopement options in the qualifier and form
'Elopements and small weddings are welcome.' in the form intro
Clear legal steps with official sources: Justiça, IRN, Smartraveller, embassies, 'Checked October 2026'
'Witnesses are optional: two to four may take part.'
Nearest airport on every region card
One Wedded Advisor from first enquiry to the wedding weekend
Advisor checks contracts for 'rooms, buy-outs, minimums and VAT'
turn_offs_noticed: Minimums hidden until the call: 'Guests: Ask your Wedded Advisor' five times and no minimum spend anywhere
Leaning to big scale: palace headline, palace booking rules, three-day weekend with a late party, exclusive use warnings
Small weddings only named clearly near the bottom (form) and in FAQ 9, not at the top

emotional_response.overall: Relieved on the paperwork, uneasy on money
emotional_response.detail: The legal tab made me feel I could actually do this. The palaces and the weekend list made me feel this is for bigger, richer weddings than ours, and the missing numbers made me wonder what they're not telling me.

payload.decision_reason: Small groups are clearly welcome where it counts (Under 30 and Elopement in the form, 'Elopements and small weddings are welcome', FAQ 9) and the legal steps are the clearest I've seen, so the form feels safe to send. It's a narrow yes: I'm only enquiring because I can put our budget and guest count in the form and ask about minimums myself, since the page never tells me the minimum spend and says 'There is no set Portugal package'.
payload.verbatim_reaction: Okay, the legal bit is really good, I actually get it now, and witnesses are optional which is a relief. But every time I look for how many guests a place takes it says ask your advisor, and there's no price at all, not even a rough minimum. And 'no set package' when I wanted a package. Still, the form has 'under 30' and 'elopement' and says small weddings are welcome, so I'll send it and put our budget in and ask straight out what the minimum is. If they come back with a 100-guest pitch I'm out.
